activities.name: List of File with Error - SUMMARY

source.sqlReaderQuery:
WITH FILELIST AS (
SELECT  
    RunDate
    ,StatusDescription
    ,CASE 
        WHEN StatusDescription LIKE 'FAILED - ErrorCode=DelimitedTextMoreColumnsThanDefined%'
        THEN NULLIF(SUBSTRING(ISNULL(StatusDescription,'')
            ,CHARINDEX('CBC', ISNULL(StatusDescription,''))
            ,CHARINDEX('.csv', ISNULL(StatusDescription,''))-CHARINDEX('CBC', ISNULL(StatusDescription,''))),'')
        ELSE NULL
    END as FileName
FROM    d360.ExecutionLog_bu_20230120
WHERE   StatusDescription <> 'SUCCESS')

SELECT 
    RUNDATE
    ,SUBSTRING(FILENAME,7,3) SOURCE_CODE
    ,FILENAME
    ,StatusDescription
FROM FILELIST
WHERE FILENAME IS NOT NULL
